godot_doom_gdextension.subject:
Make the controls card a resource instead of a hardcoded scene

Each line of the card is a PureDoomControl resource - a label plus the plain-text
input for keyboard, Xbox, Nintendo and PlayStation, with an empty device dropping
that line - and resources/controls.tres is the example holding DOOM's own. The
overlay reads them, so a game changes what the card says by editing a .tres rather
than by editing the scene. pure_doom_controls.tscn is replaced by
pure_doom_controls_overlay.tscn.
